outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar-type chart showing a single calculated illumination-overhead percentage for each exposure time, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a representative micrograph, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a representative micrograph, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot showing mean±s.e.m. photobleaching decay curves; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel E is a set of representative micrographs/maximum intensity projections, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the fitted curve with shaded s.e.m.
Panel G is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the fitted curve with shaded s.e.m.
Panel H is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the fitted curve with shaded s.e.m.
Panel I is a representative micrograph time series, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel J is a line plot showing mean±s.e.m. normalized intensity across frames; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
